shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- dod ---' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---' && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files | rg '(test|spec|chatOrchestrator|CHANGELOG|package.json|test-commands)' | head -200"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la && printf '%s\\n' '--- candidate files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | rg '("'^|/)(specs|test|tests|src)|package.json|CHANGELOG|test-commands|lore'"' | head -300"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- lore ---' && ls -la .lore && for f in .lore/*; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package ---' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---' && sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- existing orchestrator tests ---' && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- config tests hook setup ---' && sed -n '1,230p' src/config.test.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- jest config ---' && sed -n '1,220p' jest.config.js && printf '%s\\n' '--- anchors/examples ---' && rg -n 'specs/|validated by|acceptance' src scripts | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n 'function doc|const doc|spec:' src/*.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts | head -100 && sed -n '230,360p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/config.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#[0-9]|specs/[''^ ]+#[a-zA-Z]|spec:'"' src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -120 && rg -n 'test.*spec|spec.*test|descriptor' scripts .github AGENTS.md | head -160"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.acceptance.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add acceptance test for beforeSession hook failures" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
